title: bot.ability.speaking.efference
description: Copy of a motor command sent to a mouth, delivered to perception at the moment the command is issued and before the sound exists in the environment.

mouth.description: Identity of the transducer this command was sent to. A body may have more than one mouth (a handset receiver and a loudspeaker are different sound sources on the same robot), so a copy says which one is producing.
mouth.title: Mouth

duration.description: Seconds of sound this command commits to, measured from the encoded audio rather than estimated. This is how long the consequences of the command are expected to last; sound arriving after it is no longer a consequence of this command.
duration.title: Duration

media_type.description: Media type of the audio this command plays out, when known.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of the audio this command plays out, in hertz, when known.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Channel count of the audio this command plays out, when known.
channels.title: Channels
